seo.title: All Features - Sciorex
seo.description: Complete list of Sciorex features: 6 AI CLIs, council mode, visual flow editor with 9 node types, vibe kanban, LaTeX editor with multi-file projects, PDF annotations, 43-type reference library, paper discovery, 59 MCP tools, 45+ shortcuts, drag-and-drop, rich text chat, git graph, split panels, 20 concurrent terminals, and more.

page.title: All Features
page.subtitle: Everything Sciorex offers — organized by capability.

sections.title: AI & Chat
items: 6 AI CLIs: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, OpenAI Codex, LM Studio, Ollama
Council mode: multi-agent debate with turn management, pass detection, and YAML persona import/export
Extended thinking (5 levels Claude, 6 OpenAI Codex, always-on Gemini) and 4 effort levels (Low to Maximum) for fine-tuning reasoning depth
Session forking: branch from any message or continue from current point
9 mention types: @file, @directory, @ticket, @epic, @conversation, @flow, @execution, @command, @library
Token counting with cost tracking, cache metrics, and tokens/second speed
Image attachments and multimodal input for supported providers
Subagent spawning for background tasks and teammate coordination
Permission modes: strict, standard, and free tool approval levels
Plan mode for structured implementation planning with review
4 chat modes: Agentic (review edits), Normal (auto-apply), Preview (live browser), Editor (code panel)
3 display modes: Focus (assistant only), Compact (paired tool calls), Extended (full debug)
Agent Teams: multi-agent collaboration with specialized roles working together
Third-party Claude-compatible API endpoints for alternative providers
Slash commands with auto-complete for agents, flows, and CLI-specific commands
Session management: custom color labels, grouping, filtering, and archiving with ticket/epic linking
Find in Chat (Ctrl+F) with match highlighting and question-to-question navigation
Custom system prompts per AI provider with append/replace modes and reusable templates
Per-agent model and provider selection, tool permissions with pattern matching, and I/O schema validation
Agent Runs dashboard: monitor active and completed sessions with status, duration, costs, and conversation replay
Also includes: message queue for follow-ups, configurable send shortcuts, rich text input with markdown and attachments, stop generation and retry

sections.title: Visual Workflows
items: Drag-and-drop flow editor with 9 node types: Agent, Trigger, Condition, Wait, Parallel, Merge, Transform, Ticket Action, End
4 trigger types: manual with input schemas, ticket-created, ticket-updated, cron schedule
Debug mode with step-by-step execution, breakpoints, input/output modification, and time-travel replay
3 transform types: jq path expressions, template interpolation, sandboxed JavaScript
3 merge strategies: wait for all, any, or first branch to complete
Wait nodes for human approval, structured input, or timed timeout
Flow variables accessible across all nodes via context paths
Worktree integration: create isolated git worktrees per agent node
Session resume and reuse across loop iterations
9 pre-built flow templates for common patterns
Community flow marketplace with install and versioning
Flow validation: cycle detection, orphan nodes, reachability analysis
Output schema validation with automatic retry on mismatch
Flow execution history with per-node result tracking, timestamps, and error details
Also includes: auto-layout (4 modes), edge waypoint routing, undo/redo with 50 snapshots, flow duplication with deep copy

sections.title: Vibe Kanban
items: Kanban boards with drag-and-drop status transitions
3 board views: Kanban, sortable list, and epics overview
Parallel AI agent execution via isolated git worktrees
Multi-worktree dashboard with per-agent diff summaries
Agentic file review: accept, reject, or modify each change individually
Chunk-based edit grouping with conflict detection and revert safety
6 ticket statuses with valid transition rules: backlog, planned, in-progress, in-review, done, cancelled
4 priority levels: critical, high, medium, low
6 ticket types: feature, bug, task, research, documentation, refactor
Subtasks with completion tracking and progress percentage

sections.title: LaTeX Editor
items: Live PDF preview with bidirectional SyncTeX navigation
3 compilation engines: pdflatex, xelatex, lualatex with automatic TeX distribution detection
90+ command autocomplete with 30+ math commands and snippet placeholders
Hover documentation for 600+ LaTeX commands with signatures and examples
Document outline: sections, labels, figures, tables, equations, theorems
Go-to-definition and Find All References for labels and citations
Real-time diagnostics and linting without compilation
16+ quick-insert templates: equations, tables, figures, algorithms, code blocks, theorems
Table, figure, and code block generators with configurable styling and format options
LaTeX symbol palette with searchable Greek letters, operators, and relations
30+ templates across 5 categories: Academic Papers, Thesis & Dissertation, Presentations, Professional, Teaching
Multi-file project support with \input, \include, and automatic main file detection
Auto-compile on save with configurable compilation settings
Also includes: code folding for sections, environments, comments, and preamble

sections.title: PDF Viewer & Annotations
items: 4 annotation types: highlight, underline, strikeout, and text notes
5 highlight colors: yellow, green, blue, pink, red
Export annotations as Markdown, JSON, CSV, or plain text with filters by type, color, or page range
Page thumbnails, document outline, and bookmark navigation
Annotations persist in PDF and sync with reference library
Select text to ask AI for explanations
Also includes: text search with match highlighting, zoom controls, page rotation

sections.title: Reference Library
items: 43 Zotero-compatible item types: journal article, book, thesis, patent, preprint, dataset, software, and more
11 citation styles: APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE, Vancouver, AMA, ACS, ACM, Turabian, BibTeX
5 import/export formats: BibTeX, RIS, CSL-JSON, Zotero RDF, EndNote XML
14 paper import sources: Semantic Scholar, CrossRef, arXiv, PubMed, DBLP, OpenLibrary, Google Books, Unpaywall, and manual entry
Collections with custom colors and icons for hierarchical organization
Tags, reading status tracking (to read, reading, read, archived), and ratings
Notes with page number association and annotation linking
23 custom metadata field types including funding, ORCID, affiliations, and license
Full-text search with filters: type, status, tags, collection, year, rating, PDF availability
In-text citation formatting and bibliography generation with clipboard export
Also includes: 35 creator types, duplicate detection by DOI and arXiv ID, paper-to-ticket linking with auto-suggestion

sections.title: Paper Discovery
items: Citation network exploration: references, citations, and similar papers
3 API sources: Semantic Scholar, CrossRef, and OpenCitations
Author search and profile browsing with full paper listings
Library-based recommendations: suggest papers similar to your entire collection
Citation graph visualization with influential citation markers
Save discovered papers directly to your reference library
Also includes: API rate limiting management with request queue tracking

sections.title: MCP Protocol
items: 59 tools across 6 servers exposed to AI agents
Research: 16 tools — LaTeX compilation, citation management, PDF reading, annotations, library CRUD
Tickets: 23 tools — ticket CRUD, subtasks, epics, queries, progress tracking, resource linking
Resources: 11 tools — agent and flow management, schema access, execution
Interactions: 4 tools — user prompts, notifications, approvals, split panel control
Secrets: 4 tools — encrypted vault with collections, request/release workflow
Permissions: 1 tool — runtime approval prompts for sensitive operations
Custom MCP server support: add your own servers via settings

sections.title: Project Management
items: Tickets with 6 types, 4 priorities, labels, and rich descriptions
Epics with automatic progress computation from child tickets
Subtasks with completion tracking and inline management
Comments, progress updates, and blocker relationships
9 linked resource types: files, directories, branches, worktrees, URLs, sessions, flow runs, councils, library items
Activity timeline tracking every action with actor info (human, agent, or system)
Flow-ticket bridge: auto-trigger flows on ticket creation, updates, status changes, or for any ticket within a linked epic
Full-text search with filters: type, priority, epic, labels, date range, blockers
Project Dashboard with stats cards, activity feed, and quick access to recent items

sections.title: Source Control & Git
items: Interactive git graph with commit history visualization
Branch management: create, switch, and compare branches
Staged and unstaged file changes with diff preview
Stash management: save, list, and apply work-in-progress
Git worktree management: create, merge, accept, and cleanup isolated workspaces
Worktree diff viewer: compare changes between parent and child worktrees
3 worktree merge strategies: merge, squash, and rebase
Also includes: commit interface with message editor, git initialization and remote management

sections.title: Split Panels & Previews
items: 11 view modes: editor, PDF, Markdown, HTML, image, BibTeX, molecule, Excalidraw, browser preview, multi-file diff, and normal
3D molecular structure viewer for PDB, SDF, MOL, and XYZ files
Excalidraw whiteboard for diagrams and sketches
Live browser preview with URL navigation
Side-by-side code editing and preview
Multi-file diff panel for reviewing agentic changes
Dev server auto-detection for ports 3000, 4200, 5173, 8080, and more
Video and audio playback for MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV, MP3, WAV, FLAC, and more
Mermaid diagram rendering and KaTeX math equations in Markdown preview

sections.title: IDE & Code Editor
items: Monaco editor with syntax highlighting for 50+ languages
7+ Language Server Protocol (LSP) integrations with auto-installer: TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, C++, Lua, TeX
VS Code integration: embedded VS Code web or external editor via bridge extension
File explorer with hierarchical tree, git status badges, and search filter
Document outline with symbol navigation
Action history panel for tracking file operations
45+ keyboard shortcuts for navigation, editing, and view switching
Vim mode for keyboard-driven editing
6 editor themes: Sciorex (Auto/Dark/Light), Tokyo Night, GitHub Light, High Contrast
External editor support: VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf via bridge extension
File search and replace across entire workspace
Problems panel with LSP diagnostics: severity filtering, file grouping, and click-to-navigate
Also includes: file tree undo/redo, cross-panel drag-and-drop, 10+ context menus, editor tab pinning and reorder

sections.title: Process & Terminal
items: Command runner for launching tasks: npm install, dev servers, build scripts, git operations — with ANSI color rendering
Process explorer with tree visualization: monitor system, renderer, CLI, git, LaTeX, MCP, and VS Code processes
Real-time CPU and memory usage tracking per process
Server auto-detection for Ollama, LM Studio, and local services
Terminal command history with favorites, search, and path-specific recall
Up to 20 concurrent terminal processes with independent state
Also includes: event listener and EventBus subscription monitoring

sections.title: Privacy & Platform
items: 100% local execution, zero cloud dependency
No telemetry, no analytics, no data collection
Encrypted local vault for API keys and secrets with collections
Cross-platform: Windows 10+, macOS 11+, Linux
Auto-update with release notes and force-update enforcement
System tray integration with agent and flow status indicators
Desktop and sound notifications with per-event configuration
26 settings tabs covering appearance, AI, editor, security, MCP, and more
Multi-window support: open workspaces in separate windows
Windows Explorer integration: right-click 'Open with Sciorex' on folders
Customizable appearance: 10 accent colors, 5 gray palettes, 4 border radius presets, 12 fonts
Community marketplace: shareable agents, flows, council personas, and LaTeX templates
Session and tab persistence with crash recovery and external file change detection
Local model management: browse, download, load, and unload models from hub
Free forever — no subscriptions, no feature gates
Also includes: first-time setup wizard, activity feed, workspace trust system, portable mode for Windows
